# <p align="center">2.3.0</p>
## Added
* Added download completion sound.
* Added the ability to download audio and playlists from Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer.
* Icons have been added next to the name of the media author, which show what platform the video/audio is from.
* Added support for new formats:
  * Video: TS, GIF.
  * Audio: OGG, AIFF, WMA.
* Added idle wave animation.
* Added the ability to search for media on YouTube, YouTube Music, and Soundcloud.
* Added the ability to change the number of searches
* Added an indicator of the number of items to be downloaded in the queue item.
* Added the ability to remove audio from a downloaded video.
* Added custom title creator with many ready-made tags.
* Added a preset system that allows you to set many custom video and audio options and speed up the setup process.
## Changed
* Changed the main program font to `Manrope`.
* Changed macOS `.dmg` installer to `.pkg` installer.
## Fixed
* Fixed `NoneType is not iterable` error. Now the popups tell you exactly what is wrong.
* Patched default options from WebView.
